description_en: Saves one or more modified data validation tasks. You can also configure settings such as whether to perform full-table validation and whether to execute the task immediately
description_zh: 保存单个或批量修改后的数据校验任务，可同时调整是否整表校验、是否立即执行等开关
name: ExecDataCheckSaveTask

parameters.help_en:
The global parameters for the validation phase. Separate multiple parameters with a line feed (`
`)
parameters.help_zh: 校验全局参数（多个用\n分割）
parameters.name: check_global_params

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform full-table validation. Valid values:

0: Partition-level validation. This is the default value.
1: Full-table validation
parameters.help_zh: 是否整表校验：0-分区为单位校验（默认） 1-整表校验
parameters.name: full_table_count

parameters.help_en:
The global parameters for the source. Separate multiple parameters with a line feed (`
`)
parameters.help_zh: 源端全局参数（多个用\n分割）
parameters.name: source_global_params

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to execute immediately after saving. Valid values:

0: No. This is the default value.
1: Yes
parameters.help_zh: 是否立即执行：0-否（默认） 1-是
parameters.name: start_immediately

parameters.help_en:
The global parameters for the target. Separate multiple parameters with a line feed (`
`)
parameters.help_zh: 目标端全局参数（多个用\n分割）
parameters.name: target_global_params

parameters.help_en: The ID of the validation task
parameters.name: task_id

parameters.help_en: The total data volume comparison threshold, used to determine whether the data volume difference between the source and target is within an acceptable range
parameters.name: total_count_threshold

data.description_en: The validation batch ID generated by this save operation. Subsequent operations such as execution, stopping, re-running, and report generation all reference this validation by this ID
data.description_zh: 本次保存生成的校验批次 ID，后续执行、终止、重跑与报告类接口均按该 ID 引用本次校验

errCode.description_en: The error code. An empty string is returned if the call is successful
errCode.description_zh: 错误码，调用成功时为空字符串

errMessage.description_en: The error message. An empty string is returned if the call is successful
errMessage.description_zh: 错误信息，调用成功时为空字符串

requestId.description_en: The request ID, used to locate and troubleshoot issues with this call
requestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，用于定位和排查本次调用问题

success.description_en: Indicates whether the call is successful. A value of true indicates success. A value of false indicates failure. If the call fails, use errCode and errMessage to identify the cause
success.description_zh: 调用是否成功：true 表示成功，false 表示失败，失败时结合 errCode 与 errMessage 排查
